header.preparing: Getting ready · nothing is being recorded yet

intro.lead: This assessment is here so we understand how you think before we meet. You complete it on your own, in your own time.
intro.step1Body: You will make a 5 second trial recording so we know your camera and microphone work. It is never sent anywhere.
intro.step2Title: You see the questions one at a time
intro.step2Body: Each question gives you thinking time first, then answering time starts. Questions are not shown in advance.
intro.step3Body: Software does not score your answers. A person watches, writes their notes and makes the decision.
intro.recordingTitle: Video and audio will be recorded
intro.recordingBody: Your video answers record your picture and voice; only the hiring team for this position sees them. They are deleted after {months} months, and you can ask for deletion at any time.
intro.consentLabel: I agree to being recorded and to my answers being reviewed for this application.
intro.consentRequired: Tick the box above to start.
intro.resumeNote: If you stop halfway you can carry on from the same link. If something goes wrong, write to <mail>{email}</mail>.

info.title: Let us get your details right
info.body: These details are only so your application reaches you. The questions start after this.

deviceCheck.title: Let us check your device first
deviceCheck.body: No question appears until this step is done, so you do not hit a technical surprise after answering.
deviceCheck.micHint: Say a few words at your normal volume.
deviceCheck.quietHint: A quiet room and headphones make this easier.
deviceCheck.trialBody: Record it and listen to yourself. Redo it as often as you like. This clip is never sent anywhere.
deviceCheck.next: I am ready, go to the first question
deviceCheck.reasonPermission: We cannot continue without camera and microphone permission.
deviceCheck.reasonTrialNone: Record the five second trial clip first.
deviceCheck.reasonTrialListen: Listen to the trial clip, then we continue.
deviceCheck.deniedNotAllowed: The browser did not grant camera and microphone permission.
deviceCheck.deniedOther: The camera or microphone could not be reached.
deviceCheck.deniedHelp: Allow it from the camera icon in your browser's address bar, then reload this page.
deviceCheck.problemHint: If the camera will not open, you can tell the team.
deviceCheck.problemSent: Your report reached the hiring team.
deviceCheck.problemMessage: Something is wrong with the device check.
deviceCheck.checkConnectionUnknown: Could not be measured. You can still record.
deviceCheck.checkConnectionLow: {mbps} Mbps upload · low, move closer to your router

stage.startFailed: The stage could not be started. Reload the page.
stage.submitFailed: The stage could not be submitted.
stage.autosaveHint: What you write and record is saved automatically.
stage.requiredBlocks: This question is required, we cannot move on without it.
stage.keepsWhatYouWrote: What you write stays even if you close the tab.

activity.placeholderLong: Write your answer here. Bullet points are fine.
activity.pickMany: You can pick more than one.
activity.fileTypeRejected: This file type is not accepted: {type}
activity.fileTooBig: That file is too large. The limit is {mb} MB.
activity.fileFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Try again?
activity.noteFallback: Length does not matter, clarity does.

media.thinkAutoStart: Recording starts on its own when the time is up.
media.thinkCameraPreparing: The camera is opening. Recording starts when the timer ends.
media.thinkCameraFailed: Recording cannot start until the camera opens.
media.thinkNote: Take notes if you like. The camera is off right now.
media.startNow: I am ready, start recording now
media.startDisabled: You can start once the camera is ready.
media.cameraError: We could not reach your camera or microphone. Allow it from the icon in your browser's address bar and reload the page.
media.micError: We could not reach your microphone. Allow it from the icon in your browser's address bar and reload the page.
media.alternativeOffer: If you cannot record at all, you may answer this question in writing; the link below is enough.
media.useAlternative: I cannot record, let me answer in writing
media.alternativeKickerVideo: Written form of the video answer
media.alternativeKickerAudio: Written form of the audio answer
media.alternativeNote: This answer stands in for the recording and is reviewed the same way.
media.autoStopNote: Recording stops by itself when the time is up and your answer is sent.
media.takeDone: Your recording for this question is done.
media.uploadProgress: Your answer is uploading in the background · {percent}%
media.uploadResumeNote: it carries on where it stopped if the connection drops
media.hintRecording: If you have finished talking you can stop early.
media.hintUploading: Uploading the last parts, one second.
media.hintDone: You can move on to the next question.
media.incomplete: The connection dropped, so part of your recording could not be uploaded. What we have was saved.
media.finishFailed: The recording could not be completed.
media.thinkNoteCameraOpening: Take notes if you like. The camera opens in a moment.
media.hintFailed: The recording could not be completed. It did not use up a take, you can try again.

done.title: All done, thank you {name}
done.body: All {count} stages were saved and sent to the hiring team at {org}. A person reads and watches them from here.
done.nextStep: What happens next: we will write to you with the outcome. If you want your answers deleted, one message is enough.
done.requestCopy: Send a copy of my answers to my email
done.copyMessage: The candidate asked for a copy of their answers.

linkProblem.invalidBody: The address may be incomplete or copied wrongly. Try clicking the link in your email again.
linkProblem.notYetTitle: This link is not open yet
linkProblem.notYetBodyDated: The assessment opens on {date}. You can come in through the same link after that.
linkProblem.notYetBody: The assessment has not started yet. You can come in through the same link later.
linkProblem.expiredBodyDated: The link closed on {date}. The assessment is still open, you can ask for a new one and the team extends it in one click.
linkProblem.expiredBody: The link closed. The assessment is still open, you can ask for a new one and the team extends it in one click.
linkProblem.completedBody: Your answers reached the hiring team. A person will watch and read them and write to you with the outcome.
linkProblem.savedTitle: What you saved is still there
linkProblem.savedBody: {completed} stages are done. On a new link you carry on from stage {next}, you do not start over.
linkProblem.requestHint: Your request goes to the hiring team, who usually reply the same day.
linkProblem.requestSentHint: The hiring team will send you a new link.
linkProblem.contactHint: If you think something is wrong, you can write to <mail>{email}</mail>.
linkProblem.requestMessage: The candidate requested a new link.
linkProblem.requestHintNamed: Your request goes to {name}, who usually replies the same day.

rights.title: Your data is yours
rights.body: You can find out what is kept about you, ask for a copy, or ask for it to be deleted. Your request goes to a person.
rights.accessTitle: I want to see what data is kept about me
rights.accessBody: You get a list of the records held about you.
rights.copyTitle: I want a copy of my answers
rights.copyBody: The written and video answers you gave are sent to you.
rights.deleteBody: Your request reaches the hiring team and is handled without waiting for the retention period.
rights.placeholder: Write anything you want to add.
rights.sentBody: The hiring team will see your request and reply by email.
